selection: goal - 2 x collision over formulation v4.2's development sets (frozen-like 120 + field 210, near-impossible episodes replaced), safety layer off; the 3.0 M start model is evaluated first
pair: v4.3 arm (finetune_v4_pair_v43.json) against v3 arm (finetune_v4_pair_v3.json): same start (SAC baseline-v3 seed 0, final 3.0 M model and replay buffer), same budget (+0.5 M), same reset seeds, same development sets; only the stage-7 curriculum and the hard-state starts differ
gate: v4.3 minus v3 at the best checkpoint on the development sets: field set (210) >= +5 points and frozen-like set (120) >= -2 points; reported with the crossing subset; test set v4 is reported, not used for the decision
purpose: Control arm of the v4.3 SAC pair (decision, 2026-10-04): the same +0.5 M continuation under baseline-v3's own stage 7, no hard-state starts, so the comparison isolates the v4.3 curriculum and starts from extra training.
